# AskFormula - Educational Tool

> AskFormula is a free online tool for students to generate and download customized mathematics, physics, chemistry, and biology formula sheets for their exams like JEE, NEET, and school boards.

## Features
- Generate beautiful, customizable PDF formula sheets.
- Select from multiple exam formats, classes, and subjects.
- Global formula search using keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+K).
- Formulas rendered accurately using KaTeX.
